text:
Situation: Dulaglutide has been on FDA's shortage list since 2022-12-15 and remained listed as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 46 months. Corvale East holds 151 syringes of the 0.75 mg/0.5 mL presentation with daily use of 3.4, providing 44.2 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows dulaglutide was first posted on 2022-12-15 and remained listed as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately 44 days. The rule‑selected option is to purchase from Eli Lilly and Company, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and operates the plant ELI LILLY AND CO.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place purchase order with Eli Lilly and Company for the 0.75 mg/0.5 mL presentation — requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to confirm delivery schedule and update inventory projections — requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Pharmacy Director to report procurement status to P&T committee at next meeting — requires P&T Chair acknowledgment.

Not recommended: No alternative sourcing or allocation changes at this time.
